claims.claim: EQT's SEC-filed Q2 2026 results reported 634 Bcfe sales volume above guidance, $666 million capital expenditures below guidance, $1.048 billion operating cash flow and $330 million free cash flow; the 10-Q also records two 10-year LNG-vessel leases expected to commence in 2028.

risks.risk: Natural-gas cash generation remains exposed to commodity prices, basis differentials and infrastructure/transport constraints; long-duration LNG commitments add execution and utilization obligations.

unknowns.unknown: The filings do not establish realized economics of the future LNG vessel capacity once leases commence in 2028.

claims.claim: Q2 execution beat production and capital-spend expectations simultaneously, while future LNG shipping commitments indicate an effort to extend market access beyond current basin economics.

risks.risk: A favorable operating quarter does not remove commodity-cycle and basis risk.
